scope: Strict AI-summary human review decision request and response contracts
checks_cover: OpenAPI publishes strict request/response schemas for the location-scoped review decision endpoint
Approve/reject and migration-defined reason codes are allowlisted and semantically paired before service dispatch
Malformed path UUIDs fail before service dispatch
The exact five-field response binds summary ID and decision to the request and maps approval to verified and rejection to rejected
Malformed or mismatched service output returns a generic no-store failure
The route retains its existing HTTP 200 response and human review boundary
rollback: Revert the shared decision contracts, route validation, focused tests, and evidence; no database rollback is required.
